description: Level-3 MOM Workorder (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML WorkRequest). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/work-order.md, description.

properties.name: workorder_no
properties.description: Identity of the Workorder (join key): its own number from the source system. It is never built from other keys; the production order is reached through production_order_ref (FOR_OPERATIONS_REQUEST).

properties.name: production_order_ref
properties.description: FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no (FOR_OPERATIONS_REQUEST). The production order that this sub-lot subdivides.

properties.name: order_index
properties.description: The index of this Workorder within its production order: its slot number.

relationships.description: The ProductionOrder (OperationsRequest) that this Workorder subdivides.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 WorkRequest = dispatch subdivision of an OperationsRequest. RULE: one index of the production order == one Workorder (a subdivision of the production order across time slots). Creates/consumes MaterialLots. Edge FOR_OPERATIONS_REQUEST to the ProductionOrder (sub-lot / order index).
isa95.mappingNote: order_index is the slot of the Workorder within its production order, no WorkRequest.WorkType. Actuals are reported per order and operation (Part 2 SegmentResponse); Part 4 actuals need a source keyed by job.
